title: Mayan flood legend of Atlan and Tulan
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Mayan flood legend of Atlan and Tulan, about ancient at Mesoamerica, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and they have these two words that they use for that place. One is >> Atlan >> and the other is Tulon.

plain: Jason Jorjani, a philosopher and researcher, told podcast host Jesse Michels in 2025 about a flood legend from the ancient Maya of Central America. He says they used two words for the place their ancestors came from, Atlan and Tulan, a point he credits to the writer Graham Hancock, and the sound of Atlan hints at a link to the lost land of Atlantis.
